node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"

printf '\\n--- relevant source ---\\n'

nl -ba /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/45b7ddabbf07/workspace/round-brief.md | sed -n '1,140p'

printf '\\n--- test config / thresholds ---\\n'

git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format= -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts example/full-config.ts | sed -n '1,260p'"

git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts example/full-config.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add example/full-config.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts && git commit -m "Refactor conversation list error handling" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- upstream relation ---\\n'
